group.name: Which Skyrim Special Edition version do you play?

plugin.name: Skyrim SE 1.6.1170 / 1.6.1179
plugin.description:
For Skyrim Special Edition / Anniversary Edition 1.6.1170 (Steam) or 1.6.1179 (GOG). Choose this for EldenRim Together and other 1.6.1170 modlists.
This is a complete Skyrim Together Reborn: disable your old Skyrim Together Reborn mod and the separate SkyParkour Together mod after installing this one, and point your SkyrimTogether executable at this mod (see the README).

plugin.name: Skyrim SE 1.5.97
plugin.description:
For Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 (the legacy port; needs SKSE 2.0.20).
This is a complete Skyrim Together Reborn: disable your old Skyrim Together Reborn mod and the separate SkyParkour Together mod after installing this one, and point your SkyrimTogether executable at this mod (see the README).
